scenes.headline: Revenue teams live in [too many tabs.]
scenes.punch: Buziness OS is [one workspace] for all of it.

vo.text: Most revenue teams run on a CRM, a dialler, a meeting notetaker and a lead database, and none of them talk to each other.
Buziness OS is one workspace for all of it.

scenes.title: Buziness OS
scenes.tagline: Sourcing, calling, pipeline and meetings for Indian revenue teams.

vo.text: Each client company gets its own workspace, with its members, plan, modules, credits and data.

scenes.headline: Every lead, [one pipeline.]
bullets: Board and table views by stage
Contacts derived from the same record

vo.text: Leads move across one pipeline, and contacts, calls and meetings all hang off the same record, so nothing gets typed twice.

scenes.kicker: AI agents that do real work
scenes.headline: Find the email. [Take the call.] Write the minutes.
bullets: A bot joins meetings and writes the minutes

vo.text: The sourcing agent gathers evidence and verifies a prospect's business email, and shows its trace so you can see how it got there.
Calls run through a softphone and are transcribed with Gemini, and a meeting bot joins your calls and writes the minutes when they end.

scenes.headline: Every AI action is [priced, metered and refunded] on failure.
bullets: Workspace admin and a platform console

items.title: Checks the role
items.sub: member, write, org admin, super admin

vo.text: Every paid action has a price in credits. A single conditional update debits the balance, so it can never go negative, and failed actions are refunded.
And every API route goes through one guard that checks the workspace, the module, the role and the rate limit before anything runs.

nodes.title: Neon Postgres
nodes.sub: Least-privilege app role; workspaces, ledger, calls

vo.text: It's one Next.js app on Railway, with Neon Postgres behind it, and Gemini, Meeting BaaS and TeleCMI doing the AI and telephony work.
Requests pass the guard first, so a workspace only ever sees its own data.
An independent security review raised six findings, and all six are fixed.
One workspace, for every revenue channel.
